scenarios.intent: Eligible elderly citizen applies for pension with valid age-proof document.
scenarios.transcript: Citizen presented details (Kamla Devi, 68, Sonari) with PDF age proof. Assistant validated portal rules and successfully submitted. Application number generated.
scenarios.learning: Direct portal validation guarantees age calculation in IST. No separate rule evaluation required.

scenarios.intent: Underage citizen attempts to apply for pension.

assertions.expected: applicant must be 60 years of age or above
assertions.observed: applicant must be 60 years of age or above (calculated age: 59 years)

scenarios.transcript: Applicant Ramesh (59) requested pension application. Validator calculated age as 59 (<60 threshold). Assistant halted submission with statutory explanation.
scenarios.learning: Statutory age validation rejects immediately prior to any database mutation.
scenarios.change_made: Enforced strict age_on calculation against Indian Standard Time (IST).

assertions.assertion: Explicit error stating age proof is required
No fake file path or phantom document admitted

scenarios.transcript: Sita Devi provided valid biographical details but no document. Tool returned document requirement error without attempting submission.
scenarios.learning: Document payload presence must be verified before schema or database calls.
scenarios.change_made: Implemented base64 check with explicit validation_error for empty payloads.

scenarios.intent: Applicant with active pending case attempts to apply again.

assertions.observed: Application SSP26444444 (PENDING) already exists for this mobile number. A pending application can be withdrawn from the status portal before applying afresh.

assertions.assertion: Prevents second active application in DB

scenarios.transcript: Mohan Lal attempted to apply afresh. Server queried active_application and detected pending case SSP26444444, advising applicant on withdrawal path.
scenarios.learning: Early deduplication prevents wasteful document parsing or disk writes.
scenarios.change_made: Added pre-check active_application check before document storage.

scenarios.intent: Senior inquires about own application status.
scenarios.transcript: Phoolmati asked for application status. Assistant returned status PENDING under block Rajapara with next-step timeline guidance. Bank details omitted.
scenarios.learning: Status queries must enforce data minimization to protect elderly citizens on kiosk screens.
scenarios.change_made: Explicit SELECT field whitelist excluding bank_account and raw document binary.

scenarios.intent: Citizen attempts to inspect another applicant's status using guessed reference.
scenarios.transcript: Citizen 9999900006 requested application SSP26555555 (owned by 9999900005). Query was scoped strictly to caller mobile; returned neutral not_found.
scenarios.learning: Never trust client-supplied ID parameters; always bind queries to token subject.
scenarios.change_made: Enforced WHERE mobile = %s in all citizen database queries.

scenarios.intent: Officer triages pending queue and inspects case dossier.
scenarios.transcript: Officer logged in with departmental credentials. Retrieved FIFO queue with SLA tracking, then opened case SSP26888888 displaying masked bank details and document metadata.
scenarios.learning: Officers need document metadata and age verification without context bloat from raw binary chunks.
scenarios.change_made: Provided doc metadata (mime, filename, verified_format) and masked bank accounts.

scenarios.intent: Officer rejects application with mandatory justification reason.

assertions.assertion: Mandatory reason recorded in audit log
assertions.observed: Age proof document blurred and illegible upon inspection.

scenarios.transcript: Officer rejected case SSP26888888 with documented reason. Service updated application to REJECTED, recorded officer:admin in audit_log, and committed transaction.
scenarios.learning: Scheme audit rules require mandatory reason for rejections so citizen knows how to cure defect.
scenarios.change_made: Enforced non-empty reason check specifically for REJECT decisions.

assertions.assertion: Audit row created with action APPROVED

scenarios.transcript: Officer approved case SSP26999999. Status updated to APPROVED, monthly benefit disbursement activated, and audit entry generated.
scenarios.learning: Decisions must be guarded by WHERE status = 'PENDING' to prevent stale overwrites.
scenarios.change_made: Added concurrency guard on update query returning application_no.

scenarios.intent: Citizen token attempts to invoke officer queue triage tool.

assertions.observed: Insufficient role: token role 'citizen' does not have access (expected 'officer').

scenarios.transcript: Citizen bearer token presented to Officer MCP endpoint. RBAC middleware detected role: citizen and rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN.
scenarios.learning: Both audience and role claims must be strictly validated on every tool invocation.
scenarios.change_made: Attached require_officer_auth to all officer tools and composite ASGI router.

scenarios.intent: Next user on shared village kiosk attempts to use expired session.

assertions.assertion: Zero PII disclosed from prior session

scenarios.transcript: Client presented token with past timestamp on shared device. Auth middleware validated exp claim and rejected with UNAUTHENTICATED.
scenarios.learning: Tokens must enforce exp claim to prevent subsequent kiosk operators from reading prior citizen records.
scenarios.change_made: Enforced JWT exp and absolute session_ends claim checks.

scenarios.intent: Network times out during submission; client retries identical payload.

assertions.assertion: Returns original reference without creating duplicate
assertions.observed: Application SSP26388655 (PENDING) already exists for this mobile number. A pending application can be withdrawn from the status portal before applying afresh.

scenarios.transcript: Citizen submitted application. After simulated timeout, client retried identical request. Server detected existing active record and returned stable reference without duplicating.
scenarios.learning: Idempotent handling and active_application checks protect database against spurious retries.
scenarios.change_made: Pre-check and concurrency guard return existing application reference.
